scorecard.venue: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium, Lucknow

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c E Malinga b Harsh Dubey

batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: c Nithish Kumar Reddy b E Malinga

batting.name: SN Thakur
batting.dismissal: run out (Ishan Kishan, Nithish Kumar Reddy)

batting.name: Atharva Taide
batting.dismissal: c DS Rathi b W O'Rourke

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c SN Thakur b DS Rathi

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b SN Thakur

balls.text: What a strike, what a finish! LSG cross the 200-run mark Slower one outside off, Akash Deep gets under it and sends it sailing over long-on

All that for this! Samad moves across to heave it across the line but gets a thick inside edge onto the off stump through his legs. Reddy keeping a calm hit to deny LSG the big hits and LSG are combusting again

And Thakur is run-out and runs away to the dugout. He swings across the line wildly to the length ball that is wide outside off. He misses completely and Samad now charges down for the bye. Thakur is ball-watching and probably stayed back to ensure Samad is not run-out. The keeper throws it to Reddy, who throws down the stumps at the bowler's end
There's Thakur! Plays a scoop past the leg stump to get going with a four. Length ball wide outside off, he walks across and directs it through the vacant region in the outfield

Bull's eye from Kishan and that's curtains for Pooran! Reddy goes for the slower one, 110.1kph, outside off, on a length. Samad swipes across the line but misses. Pooran wants the strike back and so sprints, but he is not quick enough and is well short of the ground
Length ball angling in, heaved wide of deep midwicket. Pooran wants two but there is just one
Short and wayyy down leg again, he misses the pull
Pooran knows it too, and sends it sailing into the deep square leg stands. Length ball angling in and in the slot, he clears his front leg and heaves it over the leg side
Runs in from around the wicket and bangs it short and down leg, easy leave for NickyP
Low full toss on off, driven towards cover to keep strike, 15 runs off the nine-ball over
Poor ball again, Pooran puts it away easIly. Full and straying on the pads with short fine leg and square leg in the ring, he flicks it away in the gap and collects four
High full toss on middle, 133.5kph, Samad can only plonk it over the umpire

Bouncer from over the wicket, wide of the crease, Samad pulls but connects with nothing. Harshal thinks there is an edge, appeals and then convinces Cummins to review. Nothing on the Ultra-Edge, it went off Samad's right shoulder
Full and straight on middle and leg, he clears his front leg and smacks it on the bounce to long-on

Does not get away this time. Another full toss, another wide one, Pooran manages to get a thick outside edge toe end and that evades short third. Surely, the height of the ball will be checked. In fact, it has been given as no-ball, SRH have reviewed it. The no-ball call stays
Wide again, as he spears it very full and outside off. Lands at the far end of the guide-line
Comes around the wicket and bowls a juicy full toss wide outside off, he cannot reach it
Full toss hit straight back, almost a catch. Harshal misses and it goes down to long-off
Dug in short on middle and leg, Pooran is caught by surprise. He looks to pull, then get out of the way and then again put bat to ball, misses everything. Just two runs and a wicket, what an over.
Very full on middle, the slowie again, nudged through midwicket

Sliced straight to deep cover running in. Malinga goes full and wide, very full ball that, 134.3kph. Badoni looks to go aerial over the off side but only slices it in the air off the toe end. Reddy runs in, has his eyes on the ball and takes it. Was the cross seamer
Slower full ball outside off, he has to wait for the ball to come and can only drive it back to the bowler
Bumper angling in, not much pace on it and he pulls it towards deep backward square leg. Was in the air but fell well short as it had no timing
Angling in on a length from around the stumps, 132.5kph, Pooran looks to smack it across the line but gets a thick inside edge onto his body
Very full on leg, toe-ends it to long-on
Well over mid-off, almost goes the distance. Cummins goes for a similar ball, full and angling in on middle and leg, Pooran clears his front leg and thumps it straight over
Full on middle and leg, he clears the front leg and hits it to mid-off on the bounce
Just clears mid-off by hopping and flat-batting a short ball outside off. Slower one at 120kph
In-angling almost-yorker on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Full toss outside off, 140.1kph, sliced past backward point
Fuller on middle, defended off the front foot
Full outside off, he looks to go through off but gets it off the inner half through mid-on

Nails the slow, dipping yorker, finally! Harshal goes wide of the crease and angles it on middle, Markram thinks there's another full toss for the taking. But it dips just as it reaches him, goes under the bat and rattles the stumps to give Harshal his 150th IPL wicket. SRH put a timely end to Markram's blitz
Fuller outside off, driven to cover
Direction gone wrong for Harshal, absolutely right for Pooran. It is full, angling it down leg and on the pad, he flicks it away from short fine leg
Full toss outside off now, clubbed to deep cover
High full toss despatched! It will be checked for height, but Markram gets on his toes and heaves it well over deep midwicket. It is a no-ball
Low full toss outside off, he can only bunt it down to long-on
Very full on middle and leg, driven back to the bowler
Opens the bat face to play it away from the fielder in the deep. Another full toss on off, aiming for the yorker, Pooran leans into it and manages to beat backward point and deep cover-point
Full toss on leg, heaved to deep midwicket
Slower full toss almost foxes Markram, who adjusts and pushes it back towards the bowler. A little bit of dip as well
Goes very full around off, he opens the bat face to drive it through point
Slower one on leg, punched down to long-on
Fuller outside off, driven straight to mid-off
Yorker on middle and leg, 140kph, squeezed off the inside edge onto the pad
Bangs it short but it almost never arrives to Pooran. The slower one at 117.2kph, he pulls it through midwicket
Full and speared down leg, he misses the flick. A full-stretch dive from Kishan to pouch that
Back of a length angled in on off, cross-batted down to long-on
Full on off, driven to wide mid-off for a quick one
Slanting in on a length, it is the slower one at 116.4kph, Markram looks to flick it across but misses and is hit on the back leg
Length ball outside off, punched to cover
Fuller on middle, drives it down to long-on
Full and angling in on leg, clipped through backward square leg for a brace, 133.9kph. Throw a bit wide at the bowler's end, would have been curtains for Markram had it been on target
Streaky way to get going, NickyP. Reddy almost nails the yorker on off from around the wicket, Pooran looks to push at it but gets a thick inside edge past leg
Starts off with a length ball on middle, punched down to long-on to bring up a fine half-century, his fifth this season

Stunnning catch, Malinga! Superbly done and such has been the season for Pant. Pant has tried his best but his low run of scores just refuses to leave him. Malinga goes pace off, aims for the yorker on leg. Pant leans forward as he looks to keep it out. All he does is ends up chipping it back towards the left of the bowler, who leaps in his follow-through and holds on despite falling down. Amazing catch that gives another low score for the LSG captain
Pant finds the boundary. Banged in short on leg, he crouches just a touch and pulls it through backward square leg
Yorker on off, dug out towards long-on
Very full around off, squeezes it above the bowler, hits the stumps at the other end
Slower full one on leg, pushed past extra cover towards wide mid-off
Charges down the track and has a swish across the line to the shortish ball, misses it completely
Quicker and just outside off, chopped towards cover-point, ten runs and a wicket for Dubey
Quicker one, full on off and middle, he goes back and punches it through cover
Fuller on leg, eased down to long-on to get going

Dubey gets a wicket, finally. He should have got one on the first balls of each of his first two overs, but gets his maiden IPL wicket in his third. Celebrates by running with his arms aloft. Tosses one up around off, it spins away a touch. Marsh is turned inside out and slices it towards short third where Malinga dives and pouches it
Driven down to long-off
Huuuugggeeeee! Tossed up on middle and leg, Markram gets under it and sends it sailing over the sight-screen

Has Harshal taken that in his follow-through? He's thrown the ball up almost in celebration and then just walked away. The umpires are going up to check. Was a fuller-length ball outside off, he pushes this back at the bowler, quite low. Harshal bends down low and the question is were his hands under the ball? Lots of angles being checked. The third umpire Virender Sharma takes his time and then says that he can see the ball grounded. Not out flashes on the big screen.
Short of a length ball on middle, he pulls and splits the gap between deep midwicket and deep square. Stunning placement

Edged and another tough chance goes down. Proper edge, and think Kishan should have held on. Fuller outside off, he squeezes it and gets a thick outside edge flicking the top of Kishan's outstretched right mitt.
A third straight dot ball! Slower good length ball outside off, Marsh looks to belt the cover off it , makes no connection
Yorker on off stump, he digs this back to the bowler
Just short of backward point. Was a good length ball outside off, he slices this to Reddy.
Wrong'un on middle, Marsh miscues this to deep midwicket

That would have been a stunner had Reddy hung on. Not a lot of fielders who wouldn't have even attempted that catch. Stifle short on middle, he goes back and pulls this hard and flat. Reddy hares in from deep midwicket, but the ball falls short
Gets the length ball a rip but it lands just pas the tramline outside off. Called a wide
Flatter outside off stump, he cuts this to deep extra cover's left
Tossed up well outside off, Marsh gets down on one knee and drives to long-off
Dropped by Aniket Verma at deep extra cover. Floated outside off, Markram looks to go inside-out over cover. Does not time it as well. Verma dives forward, gets both hands to it but can't hang on
Flatter outside off, he punches to deep extra cover
Fifty for Marsh and his stunning IPL 2025 continues. His fifth 50-plus score this season. Gets there by easing a length ball in middle to long-on
Flatter outside off, he punches to the left of the bowler. He dives, but a slight misfield is enough to get the batters a run
Length ball outside off, he drives this neatly to deep cover
Angled in on the stumps on the fuller side, he pushes back to the bowler with a straight bat. Dubey misfields and concedes run
Arm ball outside off, he punches to deep point for a run
Tossed up outside off, he mistimed it but still gets four. Was aiming to go over extra cover. But a hint of turn means he slices it over point. As it turns out, there are no fielders there as well.
Tad short again outside off, he punches to the left of long-off and gets two more for his effort.
Going, going... gone! Slightly short and Markram has smoked this with a straight bat over long-on. Wow! Skidder on the stumps, he rocks back and takes full toll
Down leg again, and shortish as well as Marsh ticks this with soft hands towards deep midwicket
Flatter googly at 94kph and on the pads of Markram who stays legside of it and works this to deep midwicket
Back of a length on middle and leg, he stays back and pushes to long-on with a straight face of the bat
Tad short on off and middle stump, he backs away and slaps this to deep cover
Slower length ball on off stump, he adjusts and gets this down to long-on
Oof!  Markram is in some form today. Good length ball outside off, he prods forward, waits for the ball and square drives this on the up
Knee-high full toss on off stump, he pushes this to long-on
Slower fuller length ball on middle, he ticks this to short midwicket
On-pace length ball on middle stump, he pushes to mid-on

It's made a dent on the car! Back of a length ball on his hips, he helps this over deep backward square leg and the ball hits the Tata Curvv car, stationed just behind the boundary hoarding making a solid dent on it
On-pace length ball on the stumps, Markram pushes this to mid-on
Slower good length ball outside off, he cuts this late again but straight to short third
Another short and wide delivery, another four. Outside off, he waits for it and steers it late in between backward point and short third
Short and wide again, he slams the cut to cover where a misfield allows them a run
Good riposte from Harshal. Lands the good length ball on off stump and tails it away late beating Marsh's outside edge
The Bison in the house, ladies and gentlemen! Short, wide, punished! He pumps this with some power over the deep cover fence
Starts with a short and wide delivery well outside off. Called a wide.

17 off the over! And that is once more a lovely hit by Markram. He's looking so fluent today. Fired in on leg stump, rather just out. But Markram gives himself room and slams him up and over straight down

That is a top shot from Markram! Not a poor delivery by any stretch of the imagination. On the stumps, he backs away just a touch and goes straight as an arrow over the bowler's head. The cameraman has to duck for cover.
Fullish outside off, he pushes to long-off
Not timed cleanly but Marsh gets four more, nevertheless. Angled in on middle he drags this to the leg side, but there is so much space that there is nothing deep midwicket can do
On the flatter side on the stumps, he gets this to mid-on
Fuller outside off, he drives to covers
Oh, that's a stumping chance gone a begging. Fuller down leg, Markram misses the flick, overbalances and loses his footing to slip out of his crease. Kishan though fails to collect it clearly
Similar length ball on the pads of Marsh who works this behind square for two more.
Nicely done. Length ball on his pads, he flicks this neatly through midwicket for a couple of runs
Hard length ball on off stump, he pats this to point
What timing on that! On a length on middle stump, Markram presents the full face of the bat and pushes this to the right of Klaasen at mid-off
Good length ball just outside off stump at 137.6kph hitting the bat hard. Markram punches this to mid-off
Sharp length ball on middle and leg stump as Markram watches carefully and defends back to the bowler with a straight face of the bat
Goes wide of the crease and on the fuller side outside off as Marsh drives him to cover point
Flatter and fuller outside off, he eases this to long-off to get off the mark
Fullish in length outside off, he drives to long-off
Angled in on off stump, he pushes this back to the bowler
Tossed up outside off, he lays into it and thumps him over the long-on fence

And so nearly he gets a wicket first ball. Gently tossed up well outside off, he looks to slap it away, but gets a bottom edge to Kishan. It went low and he just tried to hold it in between his legs. A very tough chance that
Yes, no and they take the run, eventually. On a length on middle and leg, he pushes towards mid-on and sets off.
Beaten by a jaffa! On a good length landing just outside off and continuing to shape it away. Marsh, to his credit, did not go chasing at that
WHACKED! Just a touch short just outside off, but Marsh is in position so early. Picks the length up early and hammers the pull over deep midwicket to get the six counter running
On a length homing in around off stump, Marsh gets stifle across and defends to cover
Hint of movement for Cummins. Lands the good length ball outside off and nibbles it away late as Marsh shoulders arms
Starts off with a bang! Back of a length ball well outside off, he gets across and hacks this up and over covers
Length ball on off, he taps it towards backward point and sprints to the other end to seal the deal for SRH. They have knocked LSG out of IPL 2025
Streaky four gets Reddy going. Full toss just outside off, he goes for the off drive but gets an outside edge through where slip would have stood
Short and wide outside off, Aniket slashed hard over backward point and gets going with four. Rathi charges to his right from deep third and throws himself off, lands awkwardly on his left shoulder
Yorker outside off, squeezed to cover and charges to the other end. Pooran has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. And at the end of the run he clutches his right hamstring
Short and wide outside off, slashed away to deep third

Edged and gone? Pant thinks so and opts for the review. Thakur spears it full and wide outside off, just inside the tramline. Klaasen looks to dig it out and Pant thinks that is an outside edge. In fact, it is not a review from LSG but an umpire's review. The Ultra-Edge shows a spike and Klaasen is out of here after a smart, attacking innings. Thakur picks up a wicket in his final over
Another full toss, dealt with in a strong manner. Klaasen stands still and whips it across the line, almost goes the distance over deep midwicket
Klaaaaas shot. Full toss outside off, he leans into it and swipes it over square leg. Noone deep there and that brings up the fifty stand
Length ball around off, punched to long-on to retain strike
Full and sprayed down leg, Pant has to dive to pouch that
Short ball outside off, pulled through midwicket, Samad gets around from long-on and stops it with a dive
Very full outside off, squeezed to backward point for a quick run
Short ball, pace taken off, he pulls it to deep backward square leg
Offcutter on a length slanting away, he gets a thick inside edge onto his leg
Very full on leg, chipped back past the non-striker
Length ball outside off, 128.3kph, punched to long-off
Yorker on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket and they sprint back for two
To the other side of O'Rourke now. He does well again to keep it to one. Another bumper that Kamindu pulls, doesn't get the boundary he is searching for
Length ball angling in, he pulls it through backward square leg. O'Rourke covers good ground in the deep and uses every inch of his tall frame to dive and save two
Goes wide of the crease and spears it full on middle, flicked to long-on
Short ball, pulled past midwicket for one
Very full just outside off, 125.4kph, squeezed in front of point
Short ball outside off, pulled to wide long-on
Length ball slanting away from the lefty, punched towards cover for a quick run
Straight up and it evades Pant running back. Bumper in line of the stumps from Thakur, Kamindu goes for the pull but top edges it and gets two for it
Length ball outside off, punched through wide mid-off
Back of a length offcutter outside off, Klaasen fails to put bat to it
Shortish and spinning away outside off, slapped down to long-off, 17 off Rathi's final over
Around the wicket, sprays the length ball wide outside off, he leaves it be
Hangs back to the length ball to whip it to deep midwicket
Length ball on the pad, clipped through midwicket for a couple

Elegant, four! Time for Kamindu to take out the signature celebration towards Rathi. Tossed up fuller this time, he takes a short stride forward and lofts it over the bowler's head. No way long-off and long-on were getting there

Bishnoi misfields and lets it through! He over-runs it and slips, the ball escapes to the boundary. Kamindu timed the flick through midwicket, away from the man in the deep. Should not have been more than two

Kamindu connects what Kishan missed. The googly on a length outside leg, it spins in towards the stumps. He quickly changes stance and plays what is a right-hander's sweep between backward point and short third
Short ball on middle, he hops and mistimes the pull through midwicket
Length ball outside off, driven to cover
Good effort in the deep - Kamindu punches the full ball,136.7kph, straight down the ground. Long-off gets around, dives and parries it to long-on to save two
Short ball outside off, he pulls it to deep backward square leg
Fuller outside off, driven straight to long-off. Another slower one, 113.8kph
Slower length ball outside off, 115kph, slapped through covers for one
Slightly shorter outside leg, Kamindu goes back and clips it through square leg for a brace to get going
Spinning away from a length, punched to midwicket
Fuller ball lands outside leg and spins towards the stumps, he keeps it out to the on side

Goes for the reverse and goes out! Kishan thinks he is playing with the spin - the googly from Rathi - but he misses it completely and sees the ball hit top of off. Once again Rathi gets out his trademark signature celebration, Pant having a word with him after that
Spinning away from a wide line, he slaps it through cover
Muscled over deep midwicket, the Klaasen special quasi-pull. Short but not too short, but he is quick to go onto the back foot and play the down-to-up pull over the on side
Full toss on middle, miscues it just over midwicket running back. Looks at the square leg umpire for the height of that ball but gets nothing in response
Very full outside off, squeezed towards mid-off. He decides late on the run and charges to the other end

Top edge and Klaasen gets away. Thakur digs it short around off, 135.6kph, Klaasen is taken by surprise. Hangs his bat out for the pull while taking his eyes off the ball. It flies off the top edge and almost goes the distance over fine leg rope
Length ball slanting away, punched to long-off
Another slower ball on a length outside off, slapped through cover-point
Greeted with a cross-batted four! Back of length outside off, it is the knuckle ball that Thakur starts with. Klaasen has all the time in the world to heave it through midwicket
Was in the but well wide of any fielders. Good length ball on off, he chips this to long-on
Follows Kishan as he backs away a touch angling the short of a length ball into his body. He completely miscues his pull towards deep fine leg
Short of a length ball outside off, he shimmies down the track and looks to belt the cover off the ball. Can only manage to bottom edge it towards the keeper

Pinned on the back of the helmet. It was the slower bouncer that did Kishan in. Is early into the pull and misses. Avesh checks on him, but Kishan has a smile on his face which is good signs. Out comes the physio for a concussion check
Oh, that's a lovely delivery. On a good length just outside off, he looks to run that fine, misses.
On a length on middle, he presents the full face of the bat and eases to long-on
Just over a leaping deep midwicket and that makes it 14 off the over. Angled in just outside off. He brings out the slog sweep and gets enough power to clear the fielder
Floated on middle, he pushes this to long-on
Flatter just outside off, he sweeps this fine for a couple of runs
Shimmies down the track to the length ball on middle, he bunts this to long-on
Wayward length ball down leg, he laps this fine for four more. Just had to get some bat on that, which Kishan did
Length ball angled in on middle, defended back to the bowler
Darts this outside off, he slaps this to deep cover's right for a couple of runs
Length ball darted on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
Flatter length ball on off, he pushes to long-off

Bring out the notebook again, Rathi! He's got the key man and there are a few words exchanged with Abhishek. Think it was the send off that put Abhishek off. The umpires have had to intervene to separate the two. Googly darted outside off, well away from his hitting arc. He looks to go over extra cover, does not get this cleanly and Thakur takes a good catch running in.
Fuller 92.8kph delivery on off, Kishan punches this to long-off
Flatter googly on off, Kishan defends

Through the hands of Pooran and that's the fourth straight six for Abhishek. Flatter shortish length ball on middle, Abhishek pulls, not of the middle of the bat. Pooran sprints to his left from deep midwicket, gets both hands to it but fails to hang on.

Three in three! What a way bring up your half-century... take a bow Abhishek! This time off 18 balls. Too full on off stump, and he brings up another IPL fifty by smoking this straight over the bowler's head for six more.
Much cleaner, and that goes much further. Good length ball outside off, was the googly. Abhishek gets hold of it and hammers it over long-on

Oh, he's got enough to clear the fence. I didn't feel he hit that as cleanly, but even the mistimed Abhishek shots go for six. Such is his bat swing. Full on the off stump, he pumps this over long-off
Darts the legbreak outside off, he stays inside his crease and pushes to deep point
Flatter googly outside off, he punches to short extra cover
Flatter and waaay outside off, called a wide
On a length on middle and leg, he works this to short midwicket and takes a quick run
Fuller and outside off stump, he pats this to cover and sets off
Backs away and charges down the track, but this time Avesh follows him and is on track. Abhishek still manages to work this towards deep backward square leg for two more
Length down leg, called a wide
Avesh shortens his length and beats Abhishek's swing. On middle stump, he stays leg side of the ball and misses
Fetch that! Avesh plants this outside leg stump, but Abhishek goes further down leg, giving himself plenty of room and deposits this over mid-on
Wayward back of a length ball on his hips, Abhishek pulls to the vacant long leg boundary
Oh, hello, Abhishek isn't looking for any sighters. That was a length ball down leg, he steps across and eyes a scoop. Misses.
He is keeping these well away from both the batters' arc. Flatter googly well outside off again as Abhishek slaps this to long-off
Flatter googly angling well across Abhishek who shoulders arms and asks for a wide. Isn't getting it
Darts the length ball well outside off, Kishan punches this back to the bowler, who gets a finger tip to it and parries it past the stumps.
Flatter googly outside off, another play and miss
Googly dragged down outside off, Kishan picks up length so quickly as he rocks back and hammers the pull to the right of deep midwicket
Flatter well outside off, Kishan throws his bat and bottom-edges towards covers
Rising back of a length ball that angles into Kishan and continues to climb after pitching. He takes evasive action and gets this to short third
Good length ball outside off, Kishan wafts at it but fails to connect
He is down the track again, but O'Rourke this time cramps him for room by following him. Abhishek has to contend with just tapping this to point
Top shot! Good length ball outside off, he backs away and dances down the track lifting this up and over covers and over the ropes as well
Juuuuust wide of a diving Nicholas Pooran at mid-off. On a length outside off, he charges down the track and gets it right of the cue of the blade. Places it to the right of Pooran
Big swing and miss and Pant catches this just over his head. Good length ball angling across the batter, who jumps down, gives himself room and only connects at thin air
Good length ball on his pad, he looks to work this away and misses. Is rapped on the thigh pad with the ball going to short fine leg

Have they strangled him down leg? Pant thinks so. Or, does he? There is some confusion. Who has called for the review? The batter for a wide or Pant for the caught behind. Ok, we have an answer. The player review has been taken by Pant for caught behind. It was a length ball angling down leg. No glove, no bat and it is a wide. LSG lose a review.
On the up through cover for four! Length ball outside off, his aim was the find the gap and he does that with precision
On a length on middle, he defends back to the bowler
Gives himself room to the length ball outside off and creams this to deep cover
Goes high.. very high and just over the ropes. On a length outside off stump at 138.9kph, Abhishek presents the full face of the blade with a full extension and gets six for his effort
On a length but that is too straight well down leg. Pant dives to his right
Oh, shot! Abhishek this time around. Back of a length ball angling across the batter, who punches this up and over covers
Oof! That is some way to get off the mark. The width was the key there. Wide length ball outside off, Kishan throws his bat at it and sends it soaring miles over deep cover
Length on middle, he defends back towards the bowler

Another hoick, another thick edge but this time there is a fielder stationed at deep third and O' Rourke has his first IPL wicket. Very similar to the second delivery of this over. Good length ball angling across Taide. He swings, gets a thick edge and Rathi takes this catch at around ankle high to his right
No luck involved there. Short of a length ball angling across Taide, who punches this neatly past point for four

An agricultural hoick gives Taide his second boundary of the innings. Good length ball angling across Taide, who almost swings himself off his feet, gets a thick outside edge that goes over short third's head
Right on target first up. Length on middle, he pushes to the off side and was searching for the run. The bowler gets quickly across to prevent it

Huge shout for lbw, not given. Will they review... nope. Hint of movement into Taide on middle and leg as Taide misses the flick. Is rapped on the pad, but think that pitched outside leg and was slipping down leg as well
A second wide in the over and that's a good take by Pant. Back of a length ball down leg and continuing to swing further ahead. Pant dives to his left and saves a few extra runs
Back of a length ball outside off stump, Abhishek stands tall and punches to deep point to get off the mark
On-pace length ball in middle stump, he works this neatly to deep square leg for a run
First runs for Taide and SRH off the bat. Such exemplary timing to get the runs counter running. On a length on middle and leg, he tucks this past square leg
Hard length ball that hurries onto Taide just outside off. Hits the splice as his attempted pull goes as fat as square leg
Strays off line. Well down leg and that's called a wide.
Length ball to start off on middle and leg, not a lot of swing, as Taide flicks this to short midwicket
